text: But it is clear, that Elementary Geometry will not furnish the means of infecting CE, according to the required conditions. This must be done either tambiety that is, by repeated trials, or by the appliestion of a curve, so constituted, that every straight line drawn from the _pide_ C, to the _divorteric_ BG, shall have the portion BE, interpreted by the curve equal to AB.
